app.name: FITD Wii Teste 04
app.short_description: Native Wii GX original LISTANIM skeletal animation preview
app.long_description: Preliminary PowerPC/GX homebrew technical prototype for the classic Alone in the Dark engine. Original LISTANIM.PAK keyframe animation preview on LISTBODY.PAK 3D models. Real game backgrounds, interpolated skeletal groups, independent 50 Hz animation clock, SD logs. NOT the complete playable FITD engine. NOT a playable game. Original game files are not included.
